basic_info.description: Charming Sunnyside Classic with Modern Touches! Nestled in the desirable Sunnyside district, this beautifully updated 2-bed, 2-bath single-family home combines classic 1924 architecture with modern comforts. Conveniently located near BART, schools, and Highways 280/101. Inside, you'll find a bright and welcoming space. This home boasts a newly renovated kitchen and bathrooms (2017), featuring exquisite quartz counters, premium Thermadore appliances, and ample cabinet storage. The generously sized living and dining room is perfect for both relaxation and entertaining and gas fireplace. The two spacious bedrooms offer ample closet space. First bedroom is your primary with bathroom with tub. Second bedroom is facing the beautiful yard and ample amount of closet space. The standout feature of this home is the versatile downstairs room - an inviting space showcasing a mix of vintage charm and contemporary comfort. With exposed ceiling beams and rustic elements, this room is perfect for a cozy home office, a creative studio or an additional relaxing retreat. Step outside into the large, beautifully landscaped yard. Features  mature lemon trees and expansive green space perfect for gardening or social gatherings. Move-in ready, this gem awaits to welcome you!
